subject: Options for mid-contract capacity add + co-term / annualize paths
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@optimahealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@optimahealth.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mid-contract capacity add — need options for co-terming and amortization

Hi Lauren,

Per our conversation this morning, Optima needs to add ~2.0x inference capacity for a new pilot going live in January. We want to avoid creating a separate 12-month commitment that would mismatch our current contract that coterms in March 2027. Can you send the feasible pricing/credit options you can offer for: (A) adding capacity now but co-terming to Mar 2027, (B) annualizing the uplift so we pay a prorated amount over 12 months, or (C) a voucher/credit arrangement we can consume over the next 9 months?

Also include the expected invoice timing and whether there are one-time setup fees for scaling the Dedicated pool. Procurement has asked for an example PO format they can use. Attaching the midterm request PDF with their usage profile.

Thanks — we need something we can show legal/procurement by Monday.

— Daniel
Head of Machine Learning Platforms
Optima Health

Attachments: Optima_Midterm_Request_Nov18.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@optimahealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mid-contract capacity add — need options for co-terming and amortization

Hi Daniel — thanks for the details and the attachment. Moving this to a short options doc so you can share with procurement. High level we can do three standard paths, summarized below; I'll attach a worked spreadsheet with numbers for your exact usage profile in follow-up.

Option A — Co-term ramp (recommended for predictable budgeting):
- Add capacity now, charge a prorated uplift through Mar 31, 2027 so the new capacity co-terms to your annual renewal.
- No setup fee; one-time provisioning charge waived for existing Dedicated customers.
- Pro: simple PO and aligns renewal. Con: higher short-term effective monthly burn.

Option B — Annualize (12-month amortized uplift):
- Add capacity now, but annualize the uplift over 12 months with equal monthly billing.
- Produces lower monthly impact but creates a non-co-termed payment schedule (we mark as an add-on on the renewal).
- Pro: budgeting-friendly. Con: renewal quantity will need to be reconciled at Mar 2027.

Option C — Voucher/Credit bucket (flexible consumption):
- We issue a fixed credit amount tied to the uplift which you draw down as usage occurs.
- Credits expire Mar 31, 2027 (can extend by agreement).
- Pro: flexibility to absorb spikes. Con: requires a prepaid or partially prepaid commitment.

Quick asks from procurement so we can produce a PO-ready quote:
1) Confirm preferred path (A/B/C).
2) Confirm expected start date (provisioning lead time: 5 business days).
3) Indicate if Optima requires invoice split by legal entity.

I'll loop in Kar to share the numerical pricing matrix and Marissa for any approval exceptions on promotional uplift discounts.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Optima_Midterm_Request_Nov18.pdf (echoed)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mid-contract capacity add — need options for co-terming and amortization

Lauren — I ran the numbers in the pricing model and attached the workbook with three scenarios matching your descriptions. Key assumptions in the sheet: 2.0x average sustained qps, same latency SLO, 95th percentile token mix. Highlights: 
- Option A (co-term prorate): effective uplift = 1.18x blended unit price for the remaining 4 months; total uplift charge = $92,400 (one invoice, prorated).
- Option B (12-mo annualize): monthly amortized charge = $9,100/mo for 12 months; total = $109,200 (lower monthly but higher total in year one).
- Option C (voucher): recommend a prepaid credit of $85,000 with 9-month expiry — gives you headroom and marginally lower total cost if usage patterns are spiky.

Discount levers: we can offer a one-time promotional uplift discount for renewals that convert the additional committed capacity into the March 2027 renewal. Suggested approval threshold: 12–15% on the uplift for committed path A or B, depending on annualized commit. Any larger concession requires commercial review.

I'll attach redwood_pricing_models_OPT-1145.xlsx with tabbed scenarios and unit-level math.

— Karthik
Head of Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_pricing_models_OPT-1145.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mid-contract capacity add — need options for co-terming and amortization

Team — quick decision from Commercial: we can approve a one-time 15% uplift discount under the following conditions: 
1) Optima signs a PO to accept Option B (12-month annualize) OR Option A (co-term prorate) and agrees to include the new capacity on the Mar 2027 renewal without material downgrades.
2) The discount is applied only to the incremental uplift (not base contract).
3) Discount approval is valid for 7 days from this email.

If Optima prefers the voucher model (Option C), we can offer a 10% credit bonus for a prepaid voucher > $75k.

Please update the spreadsheet to show the net pricing under both allowed concessions and produce a PO template for procurement.

— Marissa
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: internal_approval_note.txt (internal memo, 2KB)

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@optimahealth.com>

- Can you send a formal quote showing Option B with the 15% discount line item and an editable PO template we can use?
- We will target approval from procurement/legal by end of day Thursday and, if all good, issue the PO the same day.

Also, please confirm invoice cadence (monthly) and start date (we'd like provisioning the week of Dec 6 if possible).

I'll have procurement open the PO template in parallel.

Best,
Daniel
Head of ML Platforms, Optima Health
